rationale: The plan matches the reference on every axis: DESeq2 Wald (with edgeR QL cross-check) on raw counts for an unpaired 6 vs 6 single-batch design, explicit ~condition formula with relevel(control) and the (condition, lesional, control) contrast triple. QC precedes the test with blind VST, top-500 PCA, distance heatmap, and per-sample library size/detected-gene table, with a stated keep-by-default policy for sample_01 that requires a reason beyond depth to drop, plus a sensitivity refit without it. Filtering is minimal and justified (>=10 in >=6, smallest group), normalization is median-of-ratios inside the model, BH at alpha 0.05 passed to results() with apeglm shrinkage and unshrunken estimates retained. Enrichment uses fgsea on the full ranked list by the named Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark 2026.1 with a 15-500 window and recorded seed, and the report specifies versions, sessionInfo, thresholds, tested/significant counts, and design caveats. The transcript-length-offset caveat is somewhat over-elaborated but does not detract from correctness.
